chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who forgot the Mother of the Quran (Al-Fatiha). He (peace be upon him) said: 'If he has not yet bowed (in ruku'), let him repeat the Mother of the Quran.'

key_terms.أُمَّ الْقُرْآنِ: The Mother of the Quran, referring to Surah Al-Fatiha

ai.seo_question: What should a Muslim do if they forget to recite Surah Al-Fatiha before bowing in prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the fiqh of *nasi* (forgetfulness) in Salah, establishing that omitting Al-Fatiha before ruku' is a correctable error rather than a nullifier. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the necessity of reciting Al-Fatiha as a pillar of prayer, distinguishing between errors that invalidate the prayer and those that merely require supplementation.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about a man who forgets the Mother of the Quran (Chapter 1). Heasws said: ‘If it was so that he has not gone into the Rukū (Rukū), so let him repeat the Mother of the Quran (Chapter 1)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir, from who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who forgets ‘Umm al-Quran (al- Fatihah). He (the Imam) said, ‘If he has not yet reached Ruku‘ position, he recites it again.’”
